name: brain-waves-workbench
description: Emotiv EPOC+ driver, live EEG workbench (FastAPI + Angular) and dataset tooling.

scripts.api:types: uv --directory api run python scripts/dump_openapi.py && npm --prefix web run api:types
scripts.lint: npm run lint:api && npm run lint:web
scripts.lint:api: uv --directory api run ruff check . && uv --directory api run ruff format --check .
scripts.lint:web: npm --prefix web run lint && npm --prefix web run format:check
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck:api && npm run arch && npm run test && npm run build:web
